description: This file defines the RuntimeProcessHandler class responsible for managing agent processes in a Node.js environment. It handles spawning, messaging, and lifecycle events for agent processes, including IPC communication, process timeout handling, and session management within a larger agent framework.

classes.name: RuntimeProcessHandler
classes.description: Manages spawning, messaging, and lifecycle of agent processes using Node.js fork() and IPC, including session tracking and error handling.

methods.name: spawnProcess
methods.description: Spawns a new agent process with specified configuration and sets up IPC communication.

methods.name: sendMessage
methods.description: Sends a message to a specific active agent process via IPC.

methods.name: stopProcess
methods.description: Gracefully stops an active process by session ID.

methods.name: terminateProcess
methods.description: Terminates a process gracefully, attempting shutdown before kill.

methods.name: stopAllProcesses
methods.description: Stops all active and pending agent processes.

methods.name: cancelPendingSession
methods.description: Cancels a pending session and kills its process.

methods.name: hasActiveProcess
methods.description: Checks if a session has an active process.

methods.name: getActiveSessionCount
methods.description: Returns the number of active sessions.

methods.name: hasPendingSession
methods.description: Checks if there is a pending session.

methods.name: writeToStdin
methods.description: Sends data via IPC as a substitute for stdin.

methods.name: hasStdin
methods.description: Always returns true for active sessions, indicating stdin availability.

methods.name: dispose
methods.description: Cleans up resources by stopping all processes.
